title: Principal Engineer - Control & Automation Systems
description:
Job Description Summary

The Control Automation System Principal Engineer serves as the technical authority for automation systems, industrial controls, and operational technologies across the organization. This role leads the architecture, design, implementation, and governance of advanced control systems that enable safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing or operational performance. The Principal Engineer mentors engineering teams, drives innovation, establishes automation standards, and leads strategic initiatives aligned with business objectives.

Job Description

The world is electrifying faster than ever, and at GE Vernova, we're building the technologies that make it possible. As a Principal Engineer in Control & Automation Systems, you'll serve as a technical authority shaping the future of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) and digital substation technology. This is a role where your expertise directly influences how power reaches millions of people — and where your ideas help define what comes next.

What You'll Do

You'll lead the technical design, architecture, and delivery of advanced control and automation systems for HVDC and digital substation environments. Specifically, you will:

  • Own the technical solution for control and automation systems end-to-end — from requirements definition and architecture through to implementation, validation, and governance — ensuring designs meet customer requirements and comply with IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5, and related power system communication standards.
  • Lead HVDC control and protection design, including network and cybersecurity architecture, Substation Configuration Language (SCL) data modelling, protection logic, interlocking logic, and integration of Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs), bay controllers, merging units, and Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs) within digital substations.
  • Drive engineering excellence by identifying and implementing improvements to methods, tools, processes, and systems that enhance customer value, and by upholding Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) principles across the team.
  • Collaborate and influence across project teams, New Product Introduction (NPI), utilities, and vendors to support system integration, testing, and commissioning; provide technical consultation to cross-functional teams on manufacturing, supply chain, and field challenges.
  • Shape the profession — represent GE Vernova externally at industry conferences and in professional bodies such as IEC and CIGRE; contribute to the Patent Evaluation Board (PEB); mentor junior engineers; and support hiring, promotion, and succession planning within Engineering & Technology.


Who We're Looking For

You're a seasoned power systems engineer with significant hands-on experience in substation automation and HVDC control systems — someone who combines deep technical authority with the ability to lead, influence, and inspire.


Required

  • A formal education in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, or a related discipline is valued, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements.
  • Significant experience in power system automation or substation control engineering, including substantial experience with IEC 61850-based systems.
  • In-depth knowledge of IEC 61850 protocols and concepts, including Manufacturing Message Specification (MMS), Generic Object-Oriented Substation Events (GOOSE), SCL, and Sampled Values.
  • Strong understanding of communication networks, including Ethernet, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), and Parallel Redundancy Protocol/High-availability Seamless Redundancy (PRP/HSR) redundancy architectures.
  • Proven experience configuring and integrating IEDs, protection relays, substation bay controllers, merging units, and HMI systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Distributed Control System (DCS) platform integration.
  • Working knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 communication protocols, including IPv4, Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP), Demilitarised Zone (DMZ), Virtual Private Network (VPN), Distribution Management System/Advanced Distribution Management System (DMS/ADMS), DNP3, and Modbus.
  • Experience using IEC 61850 System Configurators and IED Connectivity Packages.


Preferred

  • Active participation in IEC, CIGRE, or equivalent industry standards working groups.
  • Experience leading root cause analysis for complex Voltage Source Converter (VSC) control and protection issues.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity design principles for industrial control systems.


Why GE Vernova

At GE Vernova, we're on a mission to electrify and decarbonize the world. That means building technologies that are reliable, sustainable, and transformative. Joining our team means working alongside some of the brightest minds in power engineering, contributing to projects that have a genuine global impact, and growing your career in an environment that values curiosity, collaboration, and technical leadership.

Additional Information

title: Associate, Interconnection
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

This role will manage the utility interconnection application and incentive process for solar and battery storage projects across the nation. As the primary point of contact with utilities, this position will streamline utility communications and internal reporting, ensuring projects move forward expeditiously.

Pivot Energy is in an exciting growth period and is looking to expand its C&I pipeline by developing an interconnection and incentive process that is scalable for the diverse markets in which we operate. This is a position with tremendous growth potential that involves working across multiple teams. The individual hired for this role must be organized, collaborative, and goal-oriented.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create scalable process – Create a process for regular communication with utility partners, as well as timeline and status reporting to the Pivot internal team members. Suggest process improvement, such as better software utilization.
  • Interconnection Applications and Incentives
    • Submits interconnection applications and tracks routine milestones under supervision, escalating discrepancies and timeline issues to senior staff as needed.
    • Accurately enters and maintains data using tools like Excel and Smartsheet, initially with guidance and increasingly with autonomy.
    • Follows established auditing procedures and participates in basic quality control reviews. Independently manages application records and milestone statuses across multiple projects or markets.
    • Ensures portfolio dashboards and tracking sheets are current and accurate. Verifies payment transactions and milestone statuses with finance and project teams.
    • Escalates issues when timelines appear at risk or when information is missing. Updates trackers (e.g., Smartsheet, Excel, Salesforce) with milestone completions and payment status.
    • Collaborates with development, engineering, and finance to maintain real-time visibility into progress and risks.
    • Communicates proactively with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with project timelines.
    • Ensures payment amounts and application formats align with utility instructions.
    • Communicates directly with utility contacts to clarify procedural updates.
    • Prepares draft summaries or entries for internal documents under supervision.
    • Leads regular email or verbal updates on portfolio status, risks, and key decisions.
    • Adapts communication approach to support the preferences and needs of different stakeholders to support reaching decisions
    • Takes ownership of assigned tasks and offers support to colleagues to meet team goals
    • Builds and maintains collaborative relationships across the team and organization
    • Tests ideas; experiments, prototypes, or pilots to validate assumptions and identify potential flaws
    • Iterates on and improves solutions over time
    • Demonstrates proficiency in data privacy and security practices, including an understanding of the importance of data privacy and security.
    • Possesses proficiency in tools commonly used for data tasks, such as Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or other entry-level data visualization tools necessary for the position.
    • ability to break down complex problems into manageable components, understands the relationships between different elements, and identifies patterns or trends
    • resourcefulness in seeking out information, tools, or support that can help address challenges effectively, and develops or documents information necessary to reduce future issues
    • Offers constructive feedback that encourages alignment with organizational values
    • Database of Interconnection and Incentive Requirements
      • Apply utility and incentive requirements, including document and timeline requirements for specific utilities and incentive programs.
      • Maintain database of utility tariffs, interconnection manuals, net metering requirements, utility service manuals, filing resources, capacity/line resources, utility points of contact, program approval timelines, and general interconnection application/study fees
      • Learn – Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, and participating in professional societies

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills, including Document Control.
  • Experience working on teams and independently
  • Passion to learn new things through self-study and structured settings
  • Demonstrated abilities to coordinate across internal and external teams

PREFERRED COMPETENCIES

  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 2 years' experience in electrical infrastructure engineering, with a focus on utility coordination and load interconnection.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of electrical investor-owned utilities and grid interconnection processes.
  • Utility Coordination Skills: Proven experience navigating utility processes to secure interconnection points.
  • Knowledge of interconnection application, net metering, and incentive processes. Experience interacting with variety of utilities across the country
Recruitment Agency Notice:
We appreciate your interest in partnering with us; however, we are not seeking recruitment agency support for this role.

ABOUT PIVOT

Pivot Energy is a national renewable energy provider that develops, finances, builds, owns, and manages solar and energy storage projects that help decarbonize our nation’s electricity, increase equitable access to clean energy for local communities, and provide real cost-savings to American businesses and
families.
We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. We are committed to positively contributing to the local communities and people we serve with more than clean energy. We believe global warming poses an existential threat to our planet and that we have a responsibility to help mitigate the threat. Our portfolio includes projects that reduce energy burden for income-limited families, create workforce pathways for under-represented groups within the solar industry, and include robust community investment opportunities.
As a Certified B Corporation and one of Denver’s “Best Places to Work”, we believe that company success is driven by a healthy environment, thriving society, and workplace where all individuals are respected. We evaluate every internal decision on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors to determine if our actions will result in a net positive impact on the community, our employees, customers, shareholders, and the environment. Learn more in our annual ESG Report.
At Pivot, our core values guide our work internally and externally:
·Impact – We hold ourselves accountable to having a measurable impact on our people, communities, and the planet
·Balance – Put family first; work hard/have fun
·Determination – Find ways to be successful no matter how difficult the challenge
·Professionalism – Impress everyone we touch, be a team player
·Honesty – Be truthful and transparent, externally and internally

description:
Red Nucleus is hiring an experienced Commercial Consultant to our growing Advisory team.

Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services (commercial, market access, medical affairs), and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 1,000 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.

At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a “Great Place to Work".

How you will contribute

In this position, you will be working with our Commercial Consulting team. For more information about our commercial team, please visit Commercial | Red Nucleus.

As a Commercial Consultant (Senior Analyst, Associate Consultant, Consultant, and Senior Consultant roles also available, depending on experience and fit) at Red Nucleus, you will be at the center of a successful global consulting organization, assisting clients including biopharmaceutical and generic manufacturers, device and diagnostic companies, and financial, legal and investment firms – to maximize commercial success through advanced strategic problem solving, market research, analytics, project planning, and client interactions.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Manage project capabilities and proposal development by working with the project team to provide relevant secondary and primary research; identify gaps in information

  • Manage up and down to secure timely and appropriate input
  • Structure and review deliverables
  • Ensure excellent internal team communication
  • Directly apply senior feedback in creation of materials and deliverables

  • Prepare project deliverables for senior review in timely manner and in accordance with highest quality standards

About You

  • 2-3 years of direct and relevant experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech arena (Industry or life sciences consulting). Progressively more experience required for Consultant and Senior Consultant
  • Ability to work in a highly fluid, interactive, demanding, matrixed client environment and build strong, successful business partnerships
  • Depending on role fit (Senior Analyst, Associate Consultant, Consultant or Senior Consultant), progressively broader and deeper understanding of, and direct experience with, relevant healthcare market dynamics across a range of therapy areas
  • Strong critical thinking skills
  • Solid knowledge of healthcare market dynamics in major markets (US, EU5, Japan) as well as familiarity with patient, physician, and payer relationships
  • Experience working with commercial leaders in New Product Planning (NPP), marketing, commercial analytics, and/or sales functions
  • Illustrative project types may include: commercial opportunity assessment and forecasting, go-to-market strategy, indication prioritization, product launch strategy, launch planning, franchise / brand / tactical planning, lifecycle strategy, HCP / patient segmentation, stakeholder engagement strategy
  • Solid understanding of relevant disease background and product dynamics
  • Candidates may have emerging areas of specific expertise (content or project type)
  • Demonstrated ability to think and plan strategically, identify strategic options and trade-offs, effectively communicate business impact and strategic recommendations
  • Proficient at Microsoft Office applications, e.g., PowerPoint, Word, Excel

What You Will Enjoy at Red Nucleus

  • Competitive pay, incentives, retirement, and income security programs
  • Comprehensive benefits and wellness programs focused on healthy lifestyles
  • Generous paid time off, employee assistance programs and flexible work arrangements
  • Performance driven environment including professional development and transfer opportunities
  • People first culture fostering self expression, diversity, and a growth mindset
  • Celebrations! We love to celebrate service anniversaries, holidays, diversity and inclusion events, project milestones and anything else that is meaningful to our employees
  • Support of the community organizations you are passionate about
  • Ongoing programs and events designed to bring our global team together

Diversity, equity and inclusion are valued at Red Nucleus and we believe we have a shared responsibility to provide equal opportunity and foster an inclusive spirit. description:
Job Description

Turnitin is a pioneer in education technology with its roots in academic integrity, delivering flexible assessment solutions to higher education institutions, high schools, and graduate programs. With the broadest and deepest applications of AI for education, Turnitin is building innovative new products for the next decade of education. We are seeking an experienced researcher to help us increase our velocity in delivering knowledge, products, and capabilities that help educational institutions empower student outcomes with academic integrity. As a UX Researcher, you will be responsible for creating clear, user-centered product content and contributing to content decisions across the end-to-end product development process. You will collaborate closely with product and engineering partners as well as the cross-functional UX team.

To succeed in this role, you must have a solid foundation in UX and technical writing practices and be able to connect content decisions to user needs, product goals, and business outcomes. You thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where requirements can change. Our environment requires good judgment, knowing when to move quickly with clear, practical content and when to spend more time exploring, testing, and aligning on the right content approach.

A day in the life:

The UX Writer will work closely with designers, researchers, product managers, and other stakeholders on a day-to-day basis. They will write, review, and refine product content across the user experience, from interface copy and onboarding to product guidance. They will use user experience outcomes, product context, and content principles to make complex experiences clearer, more consistent, and easier to use. They will work closely within the UX Writing team, where every work day is full of collaboration, curiosity, and shared commitment to creating meaningful product experiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Write clear, concise UX copy for product experiences, including UI text, error messages, and onboarding.
  • Create and improve user guidance and release notes
  • Collaborate with UX Designers and Product Managers throughout the design process, offering copy and content feedback from early concepts through delivery.
  • Apply UX writing principles, style guidance, accessibility considerations, and user research to your content decisions.
  • Explain the reasoning behind content choices to stakeholders clearly and confidently.
  • Manage project-level feedback loops with stakeholders and respond constructively to feedback.
  • Use Jira to track, prioritize, and deliver work within a structured sprint process.

title: Lead  Control & Protection System Appication Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary

About the role
Ready to bring your skills into a role where your thinking, problem-solving and technical curiosity can help power the future?
Our Lead Control & Protection Engineer role offers someone with transferable strengths, fresh perspectives and the drive to learn the opportunity to grow and make an impact on the energy transition.
This role would suit an engineer with strong systems thinking, modelling, analysis, and technical leadership skills who wants to apply their expertise in a new domain. You may come from adjacent industries such as power systems, electrical engineering, automation, simulation, controls, protection, rail, aerospace, oil and gas, utilities, or other complex engineering environments where safety, reliability, and technical rigour are essential.

Job Description

What you will do:
• Lead and contribute to the design, modelling, verification, and validation of control and protection functions
• Build and use simulation models to assess system behaviour and performance
• Review technical solutions, identify risks, and propose safe, reliable, and compliant approaches
• Support dynamic performance studies and investigate system behaviour under fault and disturbance conditions
Technical Skills we are looking for:
• An understanding of how HVDC systems support the reliable transfer of power and the core elements that bring the system together.
• The ability to read simple technical diagrams and understand the role of key equipment, signals and interfaces within a system.
• Confidence in building and running simple models with guidance, checking results carefully and using data to support clear, reliable conclusions.
• A structured approach to control system configuration, testing and troubleshooting, with an understanding of how information moves through a system.
• The ability to support routine studies, interpret results and spot when outputs need closer review or further investigation.

About you:
We’re looking for someone who enjoys working with others, takes ownership and turns complex information into practical action. Someone who looks for better ways of working, brings ideas that improve how we deliver, stays motivated when priorities change and adapts quickly to new challenges. In this role, you help shape reliable solutions that make a real difference to our customers and the energy transition.
You do not need to have worked in HVDC before if you can demonstrate the right transferable skills, a strong learning mindset, and the ability to work with complex systems.


Why join us:
This is a chance to work on complex, high-impact engineering challenges with a collaborative team. You’ll have the opportunity to develop deep specialist knowledge while bringing fresh thinking from outside the industry and develop existing and new skills.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

title: Freelance Frontend Developer (Landing Pages & Websites)
description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Frontend Developers (HTML/CSS/JavaScript, React/Next.js) to join the Tendem project () and build high-quality landing pages and multi-page websites for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your frontend development expertise and design sensibility to build pixel-perfect, responsive, and conversion-focused websites that meet real client requirements. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in landing page production, multi-page website development, and modern frontend frameworks.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Frontend Developer, you'll design, build, and refine landing pages, waitlist pages, promo pages, and small multi-page sites (portfolios, restaurant sites, small business sites, simple online stores), turning client briefs into responsive, performant, polished web experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build landing pages, waitlist pages, and promo pages with clear hero sections, CTAs, and conversion-focused layouts.
  • Build small multi-page websites (Home, About, Services, Contact, etc.) that follow client requirements and basic information architecture.
  • Implement responsive, mobile-first layouts that work cleanly across devices and browsers.
  • Integrate forms, email capture, basic analytics, and simple CMS or headless content sources.
  • Apply on-page SEO basics (semantic HTML, meta tags, performance, accessibility) so pages are ready to rank and run ads against.
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refine frontend markup, styling, structure, and content placement to deliver production-quality websites.
  • Troubleshoot layout, performance, and cross-browser issues independently.

Requirements

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in frontend development, landing page production, or website development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Design, or related fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in modern frontend development, responsive web design, and building high-quality landing pages and small websites. We are looking for specialists who can create polished, conversion-focused user experiences, work confidently with modern frontend frameworks, and build production-ready user interfaces. A strong visual eye, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including responsive design, Flexbox, and Grid.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Astro, or similar).
  • Experience with utility-first CSS (Tailwind) or modern component libraries.
  • Ability to translate Figma designs or written briefs into clean, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with form handling, email capture services, and basic analytics setup (GA4, Plausible, or similar).
  • Working knowledge of on-page SEO, accessibility (WCAG basics), and Core Web Vitals.
  • Comfortable working with simple CMSs or headless content (Webflow, Framer, Sanity, Contentful, or similar) is a plus.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and visual taste — pages should look intentional, not generic.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to deliver complete pages with minimal supervision.
  • Portfolio of shipped landing pages and/or small websites (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

description:
Band

Job Description Summary

Location: Cambridge or East Hanover
#LI-Hybrid 3 days/week in office
Internal Job Title: The Executive Director, Applied AI Lead

Novartis is making a significant long-term investment in becoming an AI-first organization, with sponsorship at the highest levels of the company. This is a rare opportunity to shape how generative AI and agentic systems are engineered, deployed and adopted across a global enterprise whose work ultimately supports patients and healthcare systems worldwide. As Executive Director of Applied AI, you will combine technical depth, product thinking and enterprise influence to turn high-value business challenges into secure, scalable AI products and intelligent workflows. You will lead a small, globally distributed team of applied AI engineers and work directly with senior business and technology leaders to deliver measurable value at scale.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead the applied AI deployment strategy, execution roadmap and business integration model across enterprise business units.

  • Act as a forward-deployed AI engineering leader, partnering directly with business teams to translate strategic priorities into deployable products, intelligent workflows and redesigned processes.

  • Lead technical solution architecture for complex AI deployments, making hands-on decisions on application architecture, system integration patterns, model orchestration, APIs, security controls and production infrastructure.

  • Lead end-to-end implementation, customization, integration and scaling of generative AI, agentic systems and workflow automation solutions in production environments.

  • Build, lead and coach a small, globally distributed team of forward deployed AI engineers, establishing engineering excellence through technical review processes, coding standards and career development while actively guiding delivery on critical engagements.

  • Establish delivery frameworks and engineering standards that support scalability, reliability, security, maintainability and sustained operational adoption.

  • Create reusable AI services, accelerators, evaluation frameworks, blueprints and integration patterns that reduce time to value across business domains.

  • Partner with data, infrastructure, information security, architecture, compliance and business teams to align solutions with enterprise priorities and regulated-environment requirements.

  • Track solution performance, adoption and business value through monitoring, feedback loops, user analysis and continuous service optimization.

  • Guide modernization of existing systems and processes so they can integrate with agentic AI products, applied AI models and enterprise technology platforms.

  • Communicate business impact, technical transformation vision, delivery progress, risks and investment needs to senior executives and key stakeholders.

Essential Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science or a related field.

  • At least 15 years of progressive experience in technology leadership, enterprise AI transformation or complex solution delivery, including leadership of senior technical and cross-functional teams.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in applied AI delivery, including taking machine learning, generative AI and agentic solutions from concept through production and enterprise-scale adoption.

  • Strong software and product engineering grounding, with experience integrating AI into complex enterprise platforms, data environments and operational workflows.

  • Hands-on proficiency with modern AI engineering stacks, including Python, cloud platforms (e.g., AWS), LLM orchestration frameworks, vector databases, MLOps/LLMOps and software delivery practices.

  • Demonstrated success defining and scaling enterprise-level AI initiatives, with measurable business value, automation or performance outcomes.

  • Experience leading forward deployed, solutions engineering or technical consulting teams, translating ambiguous business problems into production-grade software systems in enterprise environments.

  • Consulting or professional-services experience partnering with senior technology and business leaders on enterprise transformation, operating models or technology strategy.

  • Proven people leadership and organizational development capability, including building high-performing teams, developing leaders and establishing effective governance.

  • Strong executive communication and cross-functional influence skills, with the ability to align priorities, investment decisions and delivery across a complex matrixed organization.

Desirable Requirements

  • Master of Science, engineering postgraduate degree or MBA.

  • Experience delivering AI solutions in healthcare, life sciences or another complex regulated environment, or prior zero-to-one startup experience.

Benefits & Rewards

The salary for this position is expected to range between $225,400.00 - $418,600.00 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.

US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

title: ICT Systems Engineer
description:
ICT Systems Engineer

Full-time | Permanent | Monday to Friday

Are you an experienced ICT professional who enjoys solving complex problems and making technology work better for people?

Trinity Lutheran College is a Prep to Year 12 Christian co-educational College on the Gold Coast, where exceptional teaching, authentic relationships and a commitment to helping every student flourish are at the heart of everything we do.

We are looking for someone who approaches their work with curiosity and initiative, demonstrates care for the people they support, brings ownership and purpose to solving problems, and enjoys getting beneath complex technical challenges to find reliable, sustainable solutions.

About the role

The ICT Systems Engineer plays a key role in the design, implementation, maintenance and ongoing development of the College's ICT infrastructure. Working across systems administration, networking, cybersecurity and cloud, while supporting ICT projects, system migrations and major technology rollouts across the College.

This is a role where strong technical capability is important, but what will set you apart is the way you think and solve problems. We need someone who takes genuine ownership of issues, works through challenges methodically rather than stopping at the first roadblock, and understands that great technology should ultimately make things easier and better for the people using it.

A key aspect of this role is being an escalation point for more complex technical issues and work closely with the ICT Manager to research, evaluate and implement technologies that enhance learning, communication and operational efficiency across the College.

Who we’re looking for

You are an experienced ICT professional who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building reliable, secure systems. You bring a service mindset, communicate well with both technical and non-technical people, and take pride in seeing an issue through from investigation to resolution.

You will demonstrate the ability to:

  • Design, implement and maintain enterprise-level ICT infrastructure and solutions.

  • Manage and optimise networks, systems and cloud/on-premises environments.

  • Apply strong cybersecurity practices and contribute to security monitoring, risk mitigation and disaster recovery.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and act as an escalation point when deeper technical expertise is required.

  • Contribute to ICT projects, system migrations and major software and hardware implementations.

  • Research and evaluate emerging technologies and identify practical opportunities to improve the College's digital environment.

  • Communicate technical concepts clearly and build trusted relationships with staff and stakeholders across the College.

  • Support and mentor others to strengthen ICT capability across the College.

To learn more about the role please review the Position Description - ICT Systems Engineer

A covering letter is important to us - Please tell us about a complex technical issue you identified and took ownership of. We'd love to understand how you investigated the problem, worked through the options and implemented a solution that improved reliability, security or the experience of the people using the technology.

Why Trinity?

Join a college that genuinely invests in its people, where technology exists to serve students, staff and families - not the other way around.

  • Join a college that genuinely invests in its people, where technology exists to serve students, staff and families – not the other way around.

  • Help shape how a fast-growing College manages a sprawling technology footprint.

  • Take genuine technical ownership of infrastructure, systems and complex ICT challenges.

  • Ongoing professional learning and opportunities to continue developing your technical capability.

  • Modern facilities in a central Gold Coast location, including free parking and gym.

The College expects all staff, students, and the community to embody the values and beliefs of our Lutheran school, reflecting commitment to our policies and educational excellence.

For further information about our school, please visit our website: tlc.qld.edu.au

How to apply

If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we invite you to submit your current CV and include a one-page cover letter, this forms an important part of our selection process.

title: Experience Product Manager
description:
With over 1.3 million members RAC is one of WA’s most iconic and trusted brands. We are a purpose-led member organisation striving to create greater value for our members and deliver on our purpose to be “The driving force for a better WA.”


An exciting opportunity now exists for an Experience Product Manager to join our Member Experience team on a 24-month max term contract.

As the Experience Product Manager, you will lead the strategy, roadmap and delivery of digital tools and data products that help us understand and improve our members’ digital experience. Working with teams across the organisation and a squad of data analysts, you'll ensure data, member feedback and experience insights are translated into actions that improve our digital experiences.


Note: This role leads digital experience performance data products and data analysts, leveraging source system data and platforms such as Qualtrics and VWO to derive insights. Google Analytics platform management and SEO tool ownership sit outside the role and insights are leveraged in partnership with other teams.


What will you be doing?

  • Define and drive the strategic direction for digital experience measurement tools and digital data products, ensuring alignment with business objectives and member outcomes.
  • Own the product lifecycle from strategy and roadmap through delivery, optimisation and retirement, driving continuous improvement and value realisation.
  • Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners, acting as the primary point of contact for digital experience performance and data products.
  • Prioritise product backlogs and enhancements based on business needs, member insights, performance data and strategic priorities.
  • Champion data-driven decision making through robust measurement frameworks, KPI tracking, performance reporting and product optimisation.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality digital solutions, managing risks, dependencies, timelines and partner deliverables.
  • Ensure all products comply with governance, cybersecurity, privacy, accessibility, data quality and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive stakeholder engagement, communication and business readiness, including product education, documentation and change enablement.
  • Monitor product performance, identify opportunities for innovation and optimisation, and recommend new digital capabilities that enhance member value and business outcomes.

What are we looking for in you?

  • Tertiary qualifications in a related business or IT discipline is mandatory.
  • Significant experience in a similar role working in a team-oriented, collaborative project delivery environment.
  • Experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager with background in either Agile based Development or Business Analysis.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering B2C, consumer-facing digital products that drive engagement, conversion or self-service outcomes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills
  • Background in vendor management, service delivery governance, or partner-led digital transformation.
  • Experience leading the delivery of ecommerce or sales-driven digital products, optimized for customer experience and commercial performance.

What can we offer you?

  • A workplace culture where our people feel valued, respected and empowered
  • Work in flexible ways that meet work/life commitments and support wellbeing
  • Professional career development and training
  • Free Roadside Assistance and discounts on RAC products and services including Insurance, Holiday Parks and Resorts, Security, Finance and Auto Services
  • Be part of a purpose led organisation that gives back to the WA community
  • Opportunities for community engagement and corporate volunteering
  • A very active Social Club – join one of the most active social clubs in Perth with over 900 members

To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit a 1-page cover letter outlining your suitability and interest in the position along with your resume.

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as RAC reserves the right to close this vacancy without notice.

title: Principal Data Solutions Architect
description:
GenLogs is building the freight intelligence platform for the $1T+ ground freight industry. Using a nationwide network of roadside sensors, cameras, and satellites — combined with commercial and open-source datasets — we capture real-time, empirical observations of commercial truck and trailer movement across the U.S. Where the industry has historically relied on self-reported data and infrequent inspections, GenLogs delivers ground truth.

That dataset powers a range of high-stakes workflows: brokers and shippers source and vet capacity, insurers underwrite and investigate against real movement patterns, and carriers and agencies fight the ~$35B in annual cargo theft and freight fraud. We're a fast-moving, well-funded company (most recently a $60M Series B) with deep roots in intelligence and tracking, and we're just getting started.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Principal Data Solutions Architect is the bridge between what GenLogs' data can do and the problems our customers most need solved. You'll spend your time in front of our highest-value current and prospective customers, uncovering their biggest pain points, communicating the "art of the possible" with GenLogs' capabilities, and rapidly translating that into proof-of-concept solutions and recommendations that unlock real value.

This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable dissecting a Snowflake schema and standing in front of a room of underwriters or brokerage leaders telling a compelling, concrete story. You'll operate as a trusted technical expert in the sales and customer journey, and as the connective tissue that carries customer reality back to our internal data science, engineering, and product teams — making sure what we build is what the market actually demands.

You'll need strong initiative: much of the value in this role comes from becoming deeply, intimately familiar with our data environment, core capabilities, and constraints faster than anyone expects, so you can innovate with confidence and credibility.

What You'll Do

Communicate the art of the possible

  • Clearly articulate GenLogs' core capabilities so customers can extract optimal value from the platform and data.
  • Compile and share relevant, concrete examples and demonstrations tailored to each customer's context and industry (brokerage, insurance, carrier, government).
  • Use storytelling to simplify complex data capabilities — walking listeners through specific examples intuitively and connecting them to broader capabilities and business impact.

Discover and diagnose customer problems

  • Meet with high-value current and prospective customers (roughly 1–2 trips per month) to share Genlogs foundational data initiatives and current-state capabilities.
  • Lead discovery on the highest-value use cases, uncovering the biggest problems and pain points, and gathering actionable feedback.
  • Field detailed technical questions in real time, serving as the technical expert in the sales process and reacting on the fly with ideas that steer conversations toward value.

Synthesize and build solutions

  • Combine deep knowledge of GenLogs data with an intuitive sense for business context to identify the most valuable problems and prioritize accordingly.
  • Rapidly innovate and develop proof-of-concept solutions to demonstrate value and validate direction.
  • Develop technical requirements, build working prototypes, and partner with internal data scientists and engineers to turn POCs into robust, scalable, production solutions.
  • Guide the work of technical teams and help stand up new, innovative capabilities.

Serve as connective tissue

  • Channel customer feedback back into the organization to inform technical development approach and priorities.
  • Act as a strong internal advocate for customer value, ensuring internal focus is aligned with real marketplace demand.
  • Partner cross-functionally with product, engineering, data science, sales, and leadership to close the loop between the field and the roadmap.

Own your ramp

  • Show strong initiative to become fully acclimated across the data environment and intimately familiar with GenLogs' core capabilities and constraints.
  • Build and maintain a reusable library of demos, examples, reference solutions, and narratives that scale your impact and the broader team's.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven experience translating between technical depth and business value — you can go deep on data and architecture, then zoom out to the "so what" for a business audience.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills — the ability to simplify complexity, connect examples to impact, and hold the room with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on data fluency: strong SQL, comfort working directly in a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake or equivalent), and the ability to explore, model, and reason through large, complex datasets independently.
  • Ability to rapidly build prototypes and data applications (e.g., Python and app frameworks such as Streamlit, or comparable tooling) to demonstrate concepts quickly.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop technical requirements and guide technical teams from concept through to a working, scalable solution.
  • Strong initiative and self-direction; comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to customers roughly 1-2 times per month.

Nice to Haves

  • Prior consulting or professional services background.
  • Direct, confident customer-facing experience, ideally as a solutions architect, sales engineer, or technical expert in a sales cycle.
  • Domain experience in freight, logistics, supply chain, transportation, or insurance/underwriting.
  • Familiarity with fraud, risk, or anomaly-detection use cases.
  • Experience feeding customer insight into product roadmaps and prioritization.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • You've become the go-to internal expert on what GenLogs' data can and can't do, and the trusted external face in high-value customer conversations.
  • You've run discovery across a set of priority accounts and translated it into a clear, prioritized view of the highest-value use cases.
  • You've shipped multiple POCs that demonstrably moved deals forward or expanded existing accounts.
  • Customer feedback you've surfaced is measurably shaping the product and data roadmap.

US SALARY RANGE

GenLogs establishes compensation based on role, level, experience, and location. Salary bands are benchmarked against high-growth technology companies and adjusted for market conditions. Equity grants are included in most full-time offers to ensure every team member participates in the company’s long-term value creation. A recruiter will provide a precise range during the hiring process.

BENEFITS

Healthcare (US based only)

  • Employer-covered comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
  • Employer contribution towards premiums of optional higher-end plans

Time Off

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Sick leave
  • Company holidays (GenLogs observes all US Government holidays)
  • Flexible leave for caregiving and medical needs

Family Support

  • Paid parental leave

Professional Development

  • Budget availability for approved professional development courses, certifications, and training

Travel Support

  • 100% travel reimbursement for all approved company travel and spending

Retirement Savings

  • 401(k) plan (US based employees)

A recruiter can provide more detail about the specific compensation and benefits associated with this role.

title: Medical Records Specialist
description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Medical Records Specialist is responsible for requesting, managing, organizing, and ensuring appropriate follow up for accurate and timely patient medical records and bills while ensuring compliance with HIPAA, third parties, and all applicable federal and state privacy regulations. This role supports client care operations by processing medical record requests, maintaining system accuracy and client profile updates, verifying documentation accuracy and timeliness, and coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance companies, and internal teams. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

What You Will Own

  • Process, retrieve, review, and load pertinent and appropriately shared medical record and bill information for clients in electronic and physical formats.
  • Receive and fulfill medical record requests from patients, attorneys, insurance companies, healthcare providers, and authorized third parties.
  • Ensure all records are complete, accurate, and compliant with HIPAA and organizational policies.
  • Upload, index, and organize medical documentation within the company's case management system.
  • Verify patient information and obtain appropriate authorizations prior to releasing records.
  • Monitor outstanding medical record requests and proactively follow up with healthcare providers to minimize delays.
  • Identify missing documentation and coordinate with providers to obtain complete records.
  • Maintain detailed tracking of requests, receipts, and processing timelines.
  • Collaborate with legal, case management, and operations teams to ensure records are available to support active cases.
  • Review medical records for completeness and escalate discrepancies or concerns when necessary.
  • Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive medical information.
  • Assist with audits and quality assurance initiatives to ensure data integrity.
  • Support process improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and reduce turnaround times.

What You Bring

Required:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of experience in medical records/medical bills, health information management, healthcare administration, or a related field or in personal injury or workmans comp managing medical records or bills.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA regulations and medical records privacy requirements.
  • Experience with digital systems and ease of navigation with multiple platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple requests while meeting deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Associate's degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
  • Experience supporting personal injury, legal, or insurance organizations.
  • Familiarity with case management software such as Filevine, Litify, or similar platforms.
  • RHIT, RHIA, or other Health Information Management certification is a plus.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: [Min} and [Max], commensurate with experience
  • Eligible for performance-based bonus
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

description:
Job Title: Account Director, Specialty Pharmacy Networks (GPO, IDN & Limited Distribution)

Job Location: New Jersey, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Title:Account Director, Specialty Pharmacy Networks (GPO, IDN & Limited Distribution)

  • Location: Remote, US

About the Job

Account Director, Specialty Pharmacy Networks (GPO, IDN & Limited Distribution)

The Account Director, Specialty Pharmacy Networks is responsible for leading contractual, and operational engagement across applicable Limited Distribution Networks (LDN), Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs), Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), and select independent pharmacy partners across Specialty Care and General Medicines portfolios reporting to the Senior Director, Specialty Pharmacy Strategic & Limited Networks.

This role serves as the lead for institutional customer engagement, and contracting execution, ensuring optimal product and patient access, financial performance, service delivery, data exchange, and overall patient experience across the distribution ecosystem. The role also leads GPO channel execution and serves as the Trade & Channel subject matter expert and customer-facing lead for Health Systems and IDNs.

We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our teams work together to advance treatment, improve products, understand unmet needs, and connect communities. We pursue Progress to make a meaningful impact on patients around the world.

Reports to Senior Director, Limited Network & Rare Blood Pharmacy Trade Accounts

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi
We are an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities

  • Account lead for Sanofi’s independent pharmacy partners, GPOs, and institutional customers

  • Execute and inform GPO and IDN Trade & Channel strategy, including customer-facing engagement, contract evaluation, GTN management, and negotiations across Specialty Care and General Medicines

  • Serve as the primary customer-facing lead for Health Systems and IDNs, addressing access, pricing, contracting, and channel strategy execution

  • Own respective accounts’ GTN performance across all OID, data, and service contracts, ensuring disciplined financial management and optimization

  • Drive network performance to improve patient access, conversion, and adherence across targeted partners

  • Establish and lead partner accountability through QBRs, performance management, and data-driven insights

  • Develop and execute strategic network and customer plans tied to measurable access, financial, and operational outcomes

  • Build and maintain senior-level relationships with key decision-makers across pharmacy operations, trade relations, and clinical stakeholders

  • Serve as the central point of coordination for assigned networks and customers, overseeing performance tracking, issue resolution, and continuous improvement

  • Ensure network partners meet required infrastructure, service, and compliance standards for limited distribution products

  • Identify and evaluate independent pharmacy opportunities to expand access in targeted or underserved geographies

  • Monitor and manage partner performance across KPIs, including patient onboarding, adherence, dispense performance, inventory, and service quality

  • Lead quarterly business reviews with external partners and internal stakeholders to assess performance and optimize collaboration

  • Partner with analytics and operations teams to translate network and patient data into actionable insights

  • Align patient, product, and pharmacy strategies across Trade, Brand, Market Access, Field Sales, Patient Services, Legal, and Compliance to ensure coordinated execution

  • Provide customer and network insights to inform go-to-market strategies, launch planning, and ongoing portfolio optimization

  • Support field teams with tools, insights, and network-specific strategies to enhance provider and patient access

About You

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required

  • 7+ years of experience in pharmaceutical market access, trade, specialty pharmacy, or network management

  • Experience managing limited distribution networks and specialty pharmacy relationships

  • Strong knowledge of GPO, IDN, and health system dynamics, including contracting and reimbursement models

  • Proven experience in contract negotiation, GTN management, and financial accountability

  • Deep understanding of specialty product access, patient journey, and distribution logistics

  • Strong communication, influencing, and relationship management skills

  • Ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional, matrixed environment

  • Ability to travel up to 30–40%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading GPO or institutional contracting strategies

  • Payer contracts experience

  • Market Access contracting experience

  • Experience working with independent specialty pharmacies within limited networks

  • Experience supporting product launches and complex distribution models

  • Advanced degree (MBA or similar)

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it is through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention, and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

title: Litigation & Civil Procedure Expert
description:
About Turing:Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.
Role Overview: Turing invites Litigation and Civil Procedure experts to join projects that fine-tune AI models like ChatGPT. You will apply your expertise in trial strategy, motion practice, discovery, and procedural rules to evaluate how AI handles complex litigation scenarios. If you enjoy analyzing case strategy, identifying procedural deficiencies, and providing rigorous legal feedback, this is your opportunity. No prior AI experience is required — your background in U.S. litigation practice is exactly what’s needed.

  • Provide detailed, high-quality annotations and written feedback to refine AI models.
  • Collaborate with researchers and project managers to align evaluation standards and project goals.

Requirements:
  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited U.S. law school; Bar admission (active/inactive).
  • 3+ years of U.S. legal practice in civil litigation, commercial litigation, or appellate work.
  • Strong reasoning skills across the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, evidence, and trial advocacy.
  • Excellent written communication and attention to detail.
  • High ethical standards; interest in AI is a plus.

  • Learn how to use AI to advance the legal field.

title: QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QA Engineer based in Germany.

This fully remote opportunity is ideal for a quality-focused software professional who enjoys ensuring the reliability and performance of modern cloud platforms. In this role, you will work closely with engineering and support teams to reproduce customer-reported issues, validate fixes, and improve product quality across both open-source and enterprise environments. You will combine manual testing, automation, and exploratory testing to deliver robust software releases while helping shape quality processes. The position offers significant ownership, exposure to cutting-edge infrastructure technologies, and the opportunity to collaborate with an international engineering team building mission-critical software solutions.

Accountabilities
  • Investigate customer-reported issues by reviewing support tickets, reproducing bugs, and documenting findings for engineering teams.
  • Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases covering both core platform functionality and enterprise features.
  • Perform manual, exploratory, regression, and functional testing throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Validate bug fixes before release and collaborate with developers to define acceptance criteria and identify edge cases.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated testing frameworks and test coverage.
  • Monitor quality metrics, analyze recurring issues, and recommend improvements to testing strategies and product quality.
  • Work across multiple environments to verify platform stability, functionality, and overall user experience.

Requirements

  • Professional experience in software quality assurance with expertise in both manual and automated testing methodologies.
  • Proven ability to analyze customer-reported issues, reproduce bugs, and create detailed, actionable bug reports.
  • Good working knowledge of Linux, including command-line operations and system troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience using Claude Code to support engineering and testing workflows.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, or workflow orchestration platforms.
  • Experience testing APIs, reviewing application logs, and troubleshooting distributed systems.
  • Ability to write automated tests using languages such as Java, Python, or TypeScript and experience with modern testing frameworks.
  • Strong written English communication skills with excellent documentation abilities.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a remote environment.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS products, open-source software, Playwright, performance testing, Java, or orchestration tools such as Airflow, Terraform, Ansible, or n8n is considered an advantage.

Benefits

  • Fully remote full-time position based in Europe and India.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Equity participation opportunities.
  • Health insurance coverage.
  • High level of ownership and autonomy within a globally distributed engineering team.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and business priorities.
  • Opportunity to work on mission-critical software used in production environments worldwide.
  • Collaborative, technically driven culture with opportunities for continuous professional growth.

description:
Description

Integration Test Engineer - ATM

Location: This is a Hybrid role. Whiteley, Hampshire

Clearance Required: This role will require attainment and maintenance of SC clearance

We are looking for an Integration Tester to join our team to help us deliver a large-scale systems integration programme.

As part of a multi discipline team the successful candidate will be responsible for the design, writing and execution of test cases, as assigned by the Test Lead. The successful candidate will interface with multiple teams, and with Customer stakeholders to create and execute tests. The role will require the ability to effectively communicate with all members of the team, ranging from technical personnel to programme leadership.

The role includes executing tests across a variety of software products, their interfaces and network & infrastructure configurations, and identifying and managing resulting defects.


What will I be doing?

  • Generating Test Cases by reviewing of requirements and design documentation, liaising with SMEs, suppliers and stakeholders

  • Documenting of test results and any defects/reporting progress, risks & issues

  • Investigating issues and working with suppliers to identify root cause and resolution

  • Analysing data, large datasets and test evidence from suppliers to show compliance to requirements

  • Identifying improvements in new and existing processes

What does Leidos need from me?

  • ISTQB/ISEB Foundation Certificate in software testing

  • Ability to work onsite 2-3 days per week

  • Excellent understanding of Testing Lifecycle and the different types of testing such as Functional, Non-Functional and Integration Testing

  • Proven track record in developing Software solutions using 1st (1GL) through 3rd (3GL) generation languages (e.g. ADA 83/95, C, C++)

  • Proven Experience using Waterfall and V model development models

  • Proven experience delivering solutions on Linux type operating systems

  • Experience of using development environments related to 1GL through 3GL generation Languages

  • Able to estimate and plan own immediate tasks and manage their completion

  • Good oral and written communication skills, confident in technical and non-technical discussions

  • Good time management and organisational skills – ability to work with minimal supervision

  • Enthusiastic, proactive, troubleshooting attitude with a willingness to learn new technologies

  • Experience of creating Test Cases based on requirements and design documents

Preferred Experience

  • Experience of Other Software Development Techniques like Agile development (e.g. Scrum)

  • Experience of delivering real-time and/or safety-related software

  • Knowledge of modelling languages (e.g. SysML, UML)

  • Knowledge of procedural and object orientated software development languages (e.g. Ada, C, C++ & Java)

  • Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g. Python)

  • Knowledge of COTS integration technologies (e.g. Apache)

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Do you want to provide electrical leadership at one of the world’s most unique, large-scale power and propulsion testing facilities?

GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Lead Power Systems & Test Engineer to join our Electrification team based in Whetstone, UK.

GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World

With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.

Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.

Electrification

Our Electrification solutions modernize grids, enable renewable integration, and strengthen energy systems. From software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks.

GE’s Power Conversion & Storage business, part of GE Vernova, provides electrification systems that are critical to customers’ power and energy needs for their high-performance applications. We work with some of the world’s major energy, maritime and industrial organizations, helping to enable a transition to energy efficiency and decarbonization, including through our specialist motors, drives and control technologies.

Let’s Talk about the Role

As Lead Power Systems & Test Engineer, you provide electrical leadership for the Marine Power Test Facility, balancing the maintenance of existing infrastructure with the installation, commissioning, and testing of new power systems and equipment.

Reporting directly to the Marine Power Test & Trials Manager. You will be a key member of the Marine Power Test Facility, engineering test and commissioning team.

You act as a key member of the engineering, test, and commissioning team, ensuring that all work meets the highest standards of safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.   • Establish and manage design documentation and drawings control as necessary.
  • Working with site leadership and EHS, manage safe systems of work, risk assessments and method statements associated with electrical work and testing.

You are an experienced, safety-focused electrical professional who brings a practical site-based background and the leadership ability to manage complex high-voltage systems and test programmes.

  • Power generation and distribution.
  • LV and MV variable speed drives and motors.
  • Ability to multi-task on a variety of projects to strict time scales.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Good report writing skills.
  • Good personal organisational skills.

Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent position based in our Whetstone, UK office.

This role is on-site 5 days a week.

description:
Aerospace Technical Documentation Specialist

Location: Newport News, VA
Job Type: Contract-to-Hire
Pay: Starting at $40.00/hour (Higher pay available based on experience)

We are hiring an experienced Aerospace Technical Documentation Specialist to support engineering, testing, and documentation activities in a regulated aerospace environment. This role combines hands-on technical work with the creation and maintenance of detailed technical documentation for manufacturing, testing, and maintenance operations.

Responsibilities

  • Perform hands-on work including mechanical assembly, wiring, bench testing, calibration, inspections, and functional verification of aerospace components and subsystems.

    • Maintain calibration records, spare parts inventory, and laboratory safety documentation.

  • Knowledge of avionics systems, schematic interpretation, and basic circuit troubleshooting.

description:
Job Description

Site Supervisor – Teesside (Static Site)

About Us:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.


For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced and proactive Site Supervisor with a strong fire alarm engineering background to oversee and support the delivery of fire alarm servicing, gas suppression systems, and mechanical suppression systems at a key static site in Teesside.

This role is ideal for someone who is not only confident leading others but is also technically hands-on, able to carry out maintenance tasks themselves, and committed to maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance, and service delivery.

About the Role

As the Site Supervisor, you will lead a team of on-site engineers and subcontractors while also completing your own planned and reactive maintenance tasks. You will ensure the effective delivery of all fire detection, gas suppression, and mechanical suppression services across the site.

You will be responsible for planned preventative maintenance, routine servicing, fault-finding, and remedial works on a range of systems, including:

  • Conventional and addressable fire detection systems

  • Networked and graphical fire alarm systems

  • Gas extinguishing systems (e.g., Argonite, CO2, Inergen, Novec)

  • Mechanical fire suppression equipment and fire extinguishers

You will act as the primary on-site point of contact, ensuring smooth operations, strong client relationships, and full compliance with site-specific safety and quality standards.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and commission scheme

  • Company vehicle, fuel card, and full PPE

  • Door-to-door payments

  • Overtime and call-out rota payments

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 7% matched pension contributions, life assurance, and employee assistance programme

  • Discounts on high street brands and Johnson Controls products

  • Cycle-to-work scheme

  • Employee referral scheme

  • Extensive training and cross-skilling opportunities

  • Access to business resource groups

  • Supportive, collaborative team culture

  • Clear long-term career development pathways

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Site Management

  • Lead, support, and coordinate on-site engineers and subcontractors

  • Build strong working relationships with the client and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction

  • Act as the main point of escalation for technical or operational issues

  • Monitor subcontractor performance and ensure all work meets required standards

  • Support the coaching, development, and onboarding of engineers and apprentices

Technical Delivery (Hands-On)

  • Personally carry out maintenance, servicing, fault-finding, and repairs on fire alarm systems

  • Support and oversee works on gas suppression and mechanical suppression systems

  • Perform integrity testing (training provided if required)

  • Assist with estimating, commissioning, and client training where required

  • Identify and communicate remedial works, system deficiencies, and upgrade opportunities

  • Ensure accurate completion of all on-site documentation, daily work diaries, and service reports

Technical Delivery (Hands-On)

  • Support and oversee works on gas suppression and mechanical suppression systems

Safety & Compliance

  • Conduct safety and quality audits to ensure compliance with legislation and company standards

  • Ensure all engineers follow site-specific safety and high-hazard environment requirements

  • Promptly identify and report health and safety concerns, near misses, and site hazards

  • Attend mandatory training and maintain up-to-date certifications

  • Ensure full adherence to RAMS, PPE requirements, toolbox talks, van audits, and accident investigations

  • Promote a zero-harm culture and drive continuous improvement in safety performance

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • Strong experience working with fire detection and fire alarm systems (primary skillset)

  • Experience with gas suppression systems

  • Understanding of mechanical fire suppression equipment
